items.headline: Week 7's best game? Impossible to choose on a wild Saturday
items.description: With five top-seven teams losing and dramatic finishes across the board, college football brought the heat in Week 7.

items.headline: Jon Sumrall, Auburn top trolls from Week 7 in college football
items.description: After the upset, Sumrall was in a celebratory mood, donning a cowboy hat fit for a Texan while striding through the hallways of Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium.

items.headline: All the top scenes from a wild, historic day in college football
items.description: There were some incredible college football scenes Saturday. Here are the best sights from a special day in the ever-chaotic sport we all love.

items.headline: No. 1 Georgia, No. 2 Notre Dame among top-eight teams to fall
items.description: No. 1 Georgia, No. 2 Notre Dame and No. 6 Alabama were among top-eight teams to stumble on a wild Saturday of upsets.

items.headline: All the numbers behind Auburn's stunning upset of No. 1 Georgia
items.description: Entering this week, unranked squads trailing the AP No. 1 team by at least 14 points had lost 195 consecutive games ... but Auburn had other plans.

items.headline: Auburn stuns No. 1 Georgia 27-24 in Athens
